note: Heuristic regex match against a data-driven pattern registry, not a parser -- high recall, low precision by design. authorization_check is 'Yes' only if an auth-looking keyword appeared within the pattern's window; 'Unknown' is NOT evidence of a missing check. needs_deep_dive flags entries worth a bounded, cited look via scripts/read_repo_snippet.py -- it is a prioritization hint, not a finding. Zero entry_points of a given kind usually means no pattern for that repo's actual framework exists yet in references/repo-patterns/entrypoint-patterns.json (extend it) rather than 'no endpoints.'
